title: Oregon Rail Heritage Center

services.name: Private Events
services.desc: The Oregon Rail Heritage Center definitely fits the bill. With the backdrop of the giant steam engines, testifying to our historic distinction, the space inspires awe - exactly the feeling you want to ignite in your guests! We offer group tours guided by one of our knowledgeable volunteer docents. Reservations are required. The discounted admissions rate for guided tours is $4 per person, and we’re happy to work with you to ensure cost is never a barrier. Give us a call to plan a visit for your group! The Center is available to rent for private events. Rentals take place during hours when we are closed to the public, and fees vary depending on the type and size of your event. To check
